# Work Item Plan

## Work Item WI-001: 后端关卡 API 与静态托管

### Identity

- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: 后端关卡 API 与静态托管
- kind: backend

### Goal

- summary: WHEN 后端服务以测试配置启动 THE SYSTEM SHALL 提供五项关卡数据 API、JSON 错误契约和可注入静态托管能力。

### Non Goals

- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法逻辑。
- non_goals: 不引入数据库、认证、外部服务或 npm 依赖。
- non_goals: 不读取或依赖 web/** 前端页面产物。

### Dependencies

- depends_on: []

### Inputs

### Outputs

- contract_id: CT-001
- capabilities: GET /api/levels
- capabilities: 200 JSON array of five level records
- capabilities: level field constraints for id name difficulty unlocked
- capabilities: API JSON error response
- capabilities: API JSON error Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- contract_id: CT-002
- capabilities: createServer dataPath option
- capabilities: createServer staticRoot option
- capabilities: start temporary port zero
- capabilities: start result origin
- capabilities: start result port
- capabilities: start result stop
- contract_id: CT-003
- capabilities: static hosting from staticRoot
- capabilities: static path traversal prevention
- capabilities: static missing response 404 text

### Tasks

- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 后端实现开始 THE SYSTEM SHALL 先在 tests/backend 中以 Node 内置测试和独立夹具编写失败契约测试，覆盖有效数据、无效数据、服务生命周期、API 路由和静态夹具行为。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN 后端契约测试失败 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用 Node 内置模块实现 createServer、start、stop、关卡数据读取校验和错误响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 请求进入服务 THE SYSTEM SHALL 实现 API 404 与 405 的 JSON 错误语义、静态缺失 404 文本语义和静态路径边界校验。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005

### Write Policy

- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
- forbidden_scopes: npm 依赖
- forbidden_scopes: 数据库、认证和外部服务

### Acceptance Criteria

- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN 服务使用有效 dataPath 处理 GET /api/levels THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 200 JSON 顶层数组，其中恰好包含五条满足字段约束的关卡记录。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN dataPath 指向缺失、不可解析或结构无效的夹具 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 500 和 Content-Type 为 application/json; charset=utf-8 的 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE 错误对象。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN start 以 port 0、测试 dataPath 和测试 staticRoot 调用 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回实际 origin、实际 port 和可等待的 stop 函数。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN 静态资源缺失或请求路径试图离开 staticRoot THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 404 文本并阻止目录穿越。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN API 收到未知路径或不支持方法 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回符合 API JSON 错误契约的 404 或 405 响应。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification

- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend/*.test.js
- manual_instruction: tests/backend 必须包含至少一个测试文件；无测试文件时判定验证失败。
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true

### Handoff Schema

- required_fields: createServer options dataPath/staticRoot; start result origin/port/stop; GET /api/levels success/error contracts; static hosting boundary
- provided_contract_refs: CT-001
- provided_contract_refs: CT-002
- provided_contract_refs: CT-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-004
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-005

## Work Item WI-002: 原生关卡选择页

### Identity

- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: 原生关卡选择页
- kind: frontend

### Goal

- summary: WHEN 用户打开关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过可注入 DOM 与 fetch 接口渲染关卡列表并在 API 失败时保留可读错误提示。

### Non Goals

- non_goals: 不实现关卡选中后的玩法逻辑。
- non_goals: 不引入前端框架、npm 依赖或浏览器自动化。
- non_goals: 不修改后端实现或后端测试。

### Dependencies

- depends_on: WI-001

### Inputs

- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels
- required_capabilities: 200 JSON array of five level records
- required_capabilities: level field constraints for id name difficulty unlocked
- required_capabilities: API JSON error response
- required_capabilities: API JSON error Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- compatibility_policy: require_all

### Outputs

- contract_id: CT-004
- capabilities: page entry web/index.html
- capabilities: page marker id=loading
- capabilities: page marker id=level-list
- capabilities: page marker id=error-message
- capabilities: script entry web/level-select.js
- capabilities: script relative reference to /api/levels
- capabilities: initLevelSelect injectable document and fetchImpl
- capabilities: level name rendering
- capabilities: level difficulty rendering
- capabilities: locked level unselectable state
- capabilities: level response validation before rendering
- capabilities: readable API failure without blank page

### Tasks

- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN 前端实现开始 THE SYSTEM SHALL 先在 tests/frontend 中以最小 DOM 替身和可注入 fetch 替身编写失败测试，覆盖页面契约、渲染、锁定态、响应校验和错误分支。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-006
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- done_when_refs: AC-008
- done_when_refs: AC-009
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 页面契约测试失败 THE SYSTEM SHALL 实现含加载、列表、错误容器的 web/index.html 和导出 initLevelSelect 的 web/level-select.js。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-006
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 前端接口获得响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 先校验数组与字段约束，再渲染名称、难度和锁定态，或在请求失败与非契约响应时显示可读错误。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- done_when_refs: AC-008

### Write Policy

- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
- forbidden_scopes: npm 依赖和浏览器自动化

### Acceptance Criteria

- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN 页面产物被检查 THE SYSTEM SHALL 提供 web/index.html、web/level-select.js、三个容器标记和对 /api/levels 的相对引用。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN 注入 fetch 返回有效五项数组 THE SYSTEM SHALL 渲染每项名称与难度并将 unlocked=false 项目呈现为不可选择锁定态。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-008
- statement: WHEN 注入 fetch 失败或返回非契约响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 保留页面框架并显示可读错误提示且不白屏。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-009
- statement: WHEN 前端测试套件运行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 只使用 Node 内置测试运行器完成非零数量测试且不启动浏览器。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification

- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: node --test tests/frontend/*.test.js
- manual_instruction: tests/frontend 必须包含至少一个测试文件；无测试文件时判定验证失败。
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true

### Handoff Schema

- required_fields: web/index.html; web/level-select.js; loading/level-list/error-message markers; initLevelSelect document and fetchImpl contract
- provided_contract_refs: CT-004
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-006
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-007
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-008
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-009
